category_edits.rationale: Blend each current recurrent state with the existing causal, padding-masked exponential pool: 80% current state and 20% pooled history with a five-interaction half-life. Training and inference share this readout because the predictor imports GRU4RecModel from train.py. Preserve the GRU backbone, embeddings, scoring, loss, optimizer, and dataset routing.

change_summary: Replace pure pooled readout with an 80/20 blend of the current GRU state and recency-weighted history in the shared training and prediction model.
